site.title: IGOR VEPRETSKI | 7YA
site.subtitle: A living personal archive of voice, impact, media, culture, and signal.
site.description: 7YA is rebuilt as a personal media system: sharper identity, visible media, and one searchable archive for everything by/about Igor Vepretski.

pillars.title: Person
pillars.copy: Public voice, biography, fatherhood, essays, interviews, and the through-line behind the signal.

pillars.title: StartOn
pillars.copy: Youth, technology, community, leadership, and the mission layer that anchors public credibility.

pillars.title: 7YA / Force
pillars.copy: Identity, media, culture, music, fashion-energy, and the movement logic behind the brand.

pillars.title: Media
pillars.copy: Public interviews, videos, posts, articles, podcasts, and source-backed proof.

featured.title: 7ya.io
featured.summary: The live site already frames 7YA around a strong manifesto. This rebuild keeps the force, but adds person, media, and archive depth.

featured.title: Living archive reference
featured.summary: The museum-style reference proves the right direction: numbered sections, source-backed cards, public proof, and living-archive structure.
